description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He
vibe: Route first, never guess, and keep every rule owned by exactly one file.
highlights: Single-owner rule governance: every cross-file rule has one owner recorded in docs/rules/rule-owners.md, with pointers elsewhere instead of restated procedure.
Strict route selection authority: routing.md owns exactly three top-level artifact routes; child workflows, profiles, and stages refine but never compete.
Absolute-path execution anchor: resolve the repo root before the first command and never issue cd into skills/ or projects/.
Machine-readable stdout discipline: keep stderr separate, never place 2>&1 upstream of a JSON/XML parser, and never batch commands through shell loops.
Explicit compatibility boundary: this is a workflow/skill package, not an app scaffold—no assumed .worktrees/, CI, or branch setup.
assessment: This file treats prompt engineering as systems engineering: routes are mutually exclusive, rules have single owners, and execution paths are pinned to absolute roots to eliminate ambiguity. The anti-slop discipline is unusually strong—it forbids shell batching, downstream parsers, and restated procedure, which are the usual sources of agent drift. The result is a deterministic, auditable pipeline where every artifact route and every rule has exactly one authoritative home.
